facility.name: Childtime Childcare Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Accredited,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 249 E ROUND GROVE RD, LEWISVILLE, TX, 75067

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program: 2 out of 10 children's records reviewed did not have a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: 3 out of 10 children's records reviewed did not have physician or emergency care facility information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: 2 out of 4 infants did not have an infant feeding plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): 2 out of 9 employee's files reviewed did not have a notarized affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: 3 out of 10 children's records reviewed did not have emergency medical authorization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: 3 out of 9 employee's files reviewed did not have an education documentation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: 4 out of 10 children's records reviewed did not have current immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: This standard was evaluated in regard to an investigation and a violation was found. There is sufficient evidence to show that a caregiver uses her cell phone for personal use while supervising children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation did not have a current sanitation inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: This standard was evaluated in regard to an investigation and a violation was found. A sleeping child was left unsupervised in an empty classroom for approximately 53 minutes while in care at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: 2 out of 10 children's records reviewed did not have current immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection: The operation did not have a current gas inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver failed to do a proper attendance check of children in her care while transitioning from one classroom to another. She also failed to identify the issue on her own.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was left completely unattended and unaccounted for within a classroom for up to 30 minutes before being discovered.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Both outdoor playgrounds had exposed nails, uneven wooden logs that presented a tripping hazard, and holes in the ground that presented a potential of injury.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: Both playground areas did not have the necessary-loose fill depth.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Ten children's records were reviewed and four were found to be missing their immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - Driver or designated employee conduct walk-through and visual check of vehicle: The operation's director did not conduct a walk-through of the bus, which resulted in a child being left on the bus.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - Driver or designated employee conduct walk-through and visual check of vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(d)(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - No Child Unattended: Based on external documentation reviewed during the course of this investigation, the operation's director left a child unattended on the bus.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - No Child Unattended (26 TAC §746.5605(4))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Based on information gathered during the investigation, it was determined that cleaning products were not properly secured and were accessible to the children. As a result, one of the children was able to get hold of a cleaning product, which led to an incident where the child injured their eye.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on information gathered during the investigation, it was determined that the caregiver involved in the incident did not see the incident as it was happening. The caregiver did not step in to remove the child from a potentially dangerous situation and she did not speak up or take any measures to prevent harm while the child was using a cleaning product.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Gas Leak Inspection: The operation does not have documentation of gas leak inspection. The latest documentation file is from three years ago.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5405)

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: Five children files are do not have immunization records. All children files reviewed a missing important required information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The operation's Infant class had five children in care with one caregiver. Based on the ages of the children in care the caregiver can only care for four children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: Two caregivers do not have pre-service training on file at the operation and have been present for over 90 days.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: One caregiver has been working at the operation since 2022 and does not have a CPR and First Aid card.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Five children have expired feeding planes on file at the opeation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Keep Records for 3 Months: There are 3 areas in the combined playground area that have exposed nails and sharp edges on the border that holds the wood chips for ensuring soft play surfaces.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Keep Records for 3 Months (26 TAC §746.4751(d))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Anchoring devices Below Level of Playing Surface: There are 2 playgrounds that do not meet minimum standards for surface levels.  30 days will be given in order to have both playgrounds at adequate surface levels for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Anchoring devices Below Level of Playing Surface (26 TAC §746.4601(6))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Keep Records for 3 Months: There are 3 areas in the combined playground area that have exposed nails and sharp edges on the border that holds the wood chips for ensuring soft play surfaces.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Keep Records for 3 Months (26 TAC §746.4751(d))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Anchoring devices Below Level of Playing Surface: There are 2 playgrounds that do not meet minimum standards for surface levels.  30 days will be given in order to have both playgrounds at adequate surface levels for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Anchoring devices Below Level of Playing Surface (26 TAC §746.4601(6))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver did not use good judgment when placing a child to sit outside the classroom while providing an alternate activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: This standard was evaluated towards an investigation. It was determined that the operation did not have a health statement on file for a child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: This standard was evaluated for an investigation and was determined that a child did not have current immunization on file at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
